subject: Headcount approval request: GTM hires (AE x2, SE x1, CSM x1)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Headcount approval request: GTM hires (AE x2, SE x1, CSM x1)

Hi Laura / Aditya —

Requesting formal approval to open and commit to four GTM roles this quarter:
- 2 x Account Executives (Mid-Market) — quota-bearing, expected ramp 4 months
- 1 x Solutions Engineer (pre-sales, distributed) — supports east & central accounts
- 1 x Customer Success Manager (SMB) — adoption + expansion focus

Rationale: pipeline has expanded in mid-market after three key platform wins; we need capacity to convert and service new ARR expected this FY. Hiring these four ASAP keeps momentum and prevents losing buyers to slower competitors.

Comp and budget: attached HCM-Req-20260528.pdf and GTM comp bands (GTM-Comp-Bands-2026-Q2.xlsx). Proposed bands are within HR ranges but note that the SE candidate we want to move on has rare MLOps + infra experience — I will flag that separately if we need an above-midpoint approval.

Asks:
- Approve headcount and funding source for FY26 (Aditya)
- Signoff on comp bands / any exceptions required (Neha / Aditya)
- Can we expedite req creation in Greenhouse so we can start sourcing immediately? (Sam Green from Greenline is standing by)

Timeline: aim to extend offers by June 10th for first AE and SE.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Mid-Market | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Marissa —

Thanks for the concise ask. I support these hires in principle — this maps directly to the revenue targets we committed to for Q3. A few quick clarifications before final signoff:
- Confirm bucket / gl code for funding (Aditya)
- For the SE role: is this remote US nationwide or region-specific? We prefer candidates available in EST for customer-facing hours.
- Confirm target OTE for AEs and CSM so I can approve above-midpoint exceptions if needed.

If all checks out, approve headcount and proceed with req creation. Please send the candidate packet when you have it for the SE (Emily Carter) — I’ll review for an expedited approval.

Laura

Thanks Marissa —

Please provide the following so Finance can sign off:
1) GL / cost center to charge for the hires (or confirm use of existing Q3 hiring bucket)
2) Estimated incremental FY26 cash burn and fully loaded cost for these 4 roles (salary + benefits + ramp hiring cost)
3) Confirmation that proposed base/OTE are within HR bands; any above-midpoint or above-band offers will need VP + Finance written approval.

Once I have that, I’ll confirm budget and update the headcount tracker. We can also consider shifting budget from headcount reserves if we need to accelerate.

Aditya

Subject: Re: Headcount approval request: GTM hires (AE x2, SE x1, CSM x1) — comp bands attached

Hi all —

Attached is the official GTM comp bands file (GTM-Comp-Bands-2026-Q2.xlsx). Quick summary (US, mid-market roles):
- AE (Mid-Market): Base $95k–$125k, OTE $190k–$260k
- Solutions Engineer (Senior): Base $130k–$165k, Total Comp $170k–$220k (OTE not typical for SE; variable tied to enablement/PS projects)
- CSM (SMB): Base $80k–$105k, OTE $120k–$150k (mix is base + small variable)

Rules: any offer above midpoint (>50th percentile) but within band requires VP signoff. Any offer that exceeds top of band requires VP + Finance approval with a written business case (comp exception form).

If you want to make an above-midpoint offer to secure a high-velocity candidate, ensure you include documented market comps and candidate rationale.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Headcount approval request: GTM hires (AE x2, SE x1, CSM x1) — candidate packet / offer request

Laura / Aditya —

Following up with a candidate packet for the SE role we’d like to move on immediately. Candidate: Emily Carter (referral via Greenline). Highlights: 7+ years in MLOps and infra, led SEs at two startups, deep experience with private deployments and KMS integrations (directly relevant). Salary expectations: open to $150k base + standard Redwood equity + benefits. That base sits ~8% above midpoint in the attached comp band.

Proposed offer (quick summary):
- Role: Senior Solutions Engineer
- Location: US — remote (EST preferred for overlap)
- Base: $150,000
- Variable / bonus: discretionary up to $15,000/yr (performance incentive, not quota)
- Start date: target July 6, 2026

I’m requesting VP + Finance written approval to extend an offer at $150k base (approx +8% above midpoint but within band). I’ve attached the formal offer packet: Offer-EmilyCarter-20260529.pdf.

If approved, Sam will extend and negotiate. We recommend moving quickly — she has offers in hand from two other infra-first startups.

Thanks —
Marissa
